headline: Exchanges Shed $5,578 Million As Coins Leave Venues And Bitcoin Holds Near 78k
narrative: Crypto exchanges posted a 24-hour net outflow of $5,578 million, equal to 2.24 percent of reserves, a heavy outflow as coins left trading venues. The pipe is accumulation: supply moved off exchanges instead of onto them for sale, while bitcoin held near 78k. Cumulative volume delta sat in the 95.5th percentile of the past 30 days, buyers in control on that same spot pipe, and bitcoin exchange reserves fell 15,080 coins over seven days to 1,251,541.
author: jordan
